method: Godot viewport mouse/keyboard events, incremental native screenshots, inspected UI bounds and saved documents; source-aware instrumented exploration, not a naive human usability study

evidence_checks.observation: All 35 clean-run captures belong to one process
Six-piece circuit: two straights and four curves
Initially selected Rock trap reproduced: no placement after three ground clicks
Choosing another asset first enables placement
Five distinct jump cards visible in Props
Rounded bump and three scenery objects retained
Clicking Undo position opens Map and leaves document unchanged
Throttle and brake inputs move actual practice car
Only one saved track file in clean storage

findings.title: 960x540 header overlays Undo/Redo
findings.reproduction: Resize to 960x540. Map occupies Undo's rectangle; Save covers most of Redo. Click Undo's centre: Map opens and document is unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Give narrow layouts a compact or second-row header, retaining visible Undo/Redo targets.

findings.title: Highlighted Rock does not enable placement on entry
findings.reproduction: Enter Objects. Rock is already highlighted. Click Rock, then three empty infield points: zero objects, mode still objects. Select Pebbles, then Rock: placement works.
findings.recommendation: Selecting a palette card should always enable placement; use the separate controls to adjust properties.

findings.title: Tool overlays consume the track at small sizes
findings.observation: At 960x540, the palette and size strip cover much of the fitted circuit. At 1280x720, confirmation and dimension labels crowd the curve. This is a visual usability judgment, not a demonstrated data-loss bug.
findings.recommendation: Fit roads into the usable canvas above palettes and offset confirmation and dimension labels.

findings.title: Preparation interrupts the edit/test loop
findings.measurement_limit: 14577ms end-to-end command includes a 1s explicit wait, a 0.6s screenshot settling delay and input frames; not pure UI latency. First-practice timing is not claimed because its initial readiness helper failed.

findings.title: Scenery coroutine accesses a freed node
findings.observation: One clean-run engine log occurrence: Cannot call method get_children on a previously freed instance, desert_road_relief.gd:178, during object placement. Authoring continued. Root cause and independent reproduction are not established.
